Dropdown Menu

Dropdown menus display a list of actions or options when triggered by a button. They support icons, dividers, checkbox items, and various positions and sizes.

Basic Dropdown

A simple dropdown with text items.

  • Profile
  • Settings
  • Billing
  • Sign out
HTML
<div style="position: relative; display: inline-block;">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">
        Options
        <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
    </button>
    <ul class="zak-dropdown-menu">
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Profile</a></li>
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Settings</a></li>
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Billing</a></li>
        <li class="zak-dropdown-divider"></li>
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Sign out</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>

Split Button Dropdown

A dropdown attached to a split button where the left part triggers a default action and the right part opens the menu.

  • Save as Draft
  • Save and Publish
  • Schedule
HTML
<div style="position: relative; display: inline-block;">
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Save</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" onclick="this.closest('.zak-btn-group').nextElementSibling.classList.toggle('visible')">
            <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
        </button>
    </div>
    <ul class="zak-dropdown-menu">
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Save as Draft</a></li>
        <li><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item">Save and Publish</a></li>
    </ul>
</div>

Dropdown with Checkbox Items

Add checkable items to dropdowns for toggle options.

HTML
<ul class="zak-dropdown-menu">
    <li>
        <label class="zak-dropdown-item">
            <input type="checkbox" checked> Show Toolbar
        </label>
    </li>
    <li>
        <label class="zak-dropdown-item">
            <input type="checkbox"> Show Sidebar
        </label>
    </li>
</ul>

CSS Classes

Dropdown menu styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Dropdown Menu */
.zak-dropdown-menu                    /* Base dropdown menu */
.zak-dropdown-menu.visible            /* Visible/open state */

/* Positioning */
.zak-dropdown-menu-right              /* Right-aligned */
.zak-dropdown-menu-center             /* Center-aligned */

/* Items */
.zak-dropdown-item                    /* Menu item link */
.zak-dropdown-header                  /* Header label */
.zak-dropdown-divider                 /* Separator line */

JavaScript

Use JavaScript to handle toggle, close on outside click, and keyboard navigation.

HTML
// Toggle dropdown on trigger click
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-btn-group .zak-btn:last-child, [aria-haspopup]').forEach(trigger => {
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const menu = this.closest('[style*="relative"]').querySelector('.zak-dropdown-menu');
        if (menu) {
            const isOpen = menu.classList.contains('visible');
            // Close all other dropdowns
            document.querySelectorAll('.zak-dropdown-menu.visible').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('visible'));
            if (!isOpen) menu.classList.add('visible');
        }
    });
});

// Close on outside click
document.addEventListener('click', function() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.zak-dropdown-menu.visible').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('visible'));
});

// Close on Escape key
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        document.querySelectorAll('.zak-dropdown-menu.visible').forEach(m => m.classList.remove('visible'));
    }
});

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using dropdown menus.

  • Use aria-haspopup="true" on the trigger button.
  • Toggle aria-expanded on the trigger when the menu opens/closes.
  • Use role="menu" on the dropdown and role="menuitem" on items.
  • Use role="separator" on divider elements.
  • Support keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Home, End, Escape, and Tab.
  • Return focus to the trigger when the menu closes.
  • Close the dropdown when focus moves outside it.
HTML
<button aria-haspopup="true" aria-expanded="false">
    Options
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-chevron-down" viewBox="0 0 24 24">...</svg>
</button>
<ul class="zak-dropdown-menu" role="menu">
    <li role="none"><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">Profile</a></li>
    <li role="none"><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">Settings</a></li>
    <li class="zak-dropdown-divider" role="separator"></li>
    <li role="none"><a href="#" class="zak-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">Sign out</a></li>
</ul>
Press ↑↓ to navigate Press ESC to close
